title: Update Clubhouse hero image and apply colorful handprints app background

requirements.summary: Replace the Clubhouse home page hero image with the new static “Cool Kidz Club” artwork asset while keeping it responsive inside the rounded container.
acceptanceCriteria: The homepage hero image on the Clubhouse home page displays the new “Cool Kidz Club” artwork instead of the current /assets/generated/clubhouse-hero-sunny-park.dim_1600x900.png image.
The hero image is loaded from a static file in the frontend (not via backend).
The hero image remains responsive and does not overflow its rounded container.

file_operations.description: Add the converted/cropped wide hero asset for the uploaded “Cool Kidz Club” artwork as a static public asset (per imageRequirements edit output filename).

Update the hero source to use the new static asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/cool-kidz-club-hero.dim_1600x900.jpg, replacing the prior generated sunny-park hero; ensure image sizing uses container-safe responsive styles (e.g., cover/contain as appropriate) so it does not overflow the rounded/overflow-hidden hero frame.

requirements.summary: Add the static “colorful handprints” image and apply it as the app-wide background (main shell/pages) with an overlay so foreground content remains readable and performance stays smooth.
acceptanceCriteria: All primary pages (Home, Parent Portal, Tours) show the colorful handprints background behind the main content.
Text, buttons, and BubbleCard content maintain good readability over the background (e.g., via opacity/overlay or other styling adjustments).
Background rendering performs well (no obvious jank) and scales appropriately on mobile and desktop.

file_operations.description: Add the background-ready “colorful handprints” static asset (per imageRequirements edit output filename) under public generated assets for fast loading and caching.

Introduce app-wide background styling that uses frontend/public/assets/generated/colorful-handprints-bg.dim_2048x2048.png behind content with a readability-preserving overlay (e.g., layered backgrounds or a semi-transparent wash) and mobile/desktop-friendly scaling/repeat behavior; keep changes in this existing global stylesheet entry point.

Apply a wrapper class/structure on the main app shell container to render the handprints background behind all routed pages (Home, Parent Portal, Tours) while keeping the header/footer and main content readable (e.g., by enabling the global overlay/background styles via className).
